paragraphs: Rav Mesharshia son of Rav Idi.

He is mentioned in [Gittin 30b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.30b.8-10) following the words of Abaye, and in [Avodah Zarah 13a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.13a.6) he resolves the words of Resh Lakish.[^1]

notes.text: Gittin places Rav Mesharshiya’s explanation after Abaye’s. In Avodah Zarah he explains what Resh Lakish held.
